children: Bajaj Finserv reported a 25 per cent year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 5,952 crore for the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 4,746 crore in the corresponding period last year, as per media reports.
Total income increased to Rs 43,416 crore during the September quarter from Rs 37,403 crore a year earlier. Interest income rose to Rs 23,824 crore from Rs 19,599 crore in Q2 FY26.
Total expenditure increased to Rs 34,812 crore from Rs 30,581 crore in the year-ago quarter.
Bajaj General Insurance, a subsidiary of the company, reported a 19 per cent decline in quarterly profit to Rs 420 crore from Rs 517 crore in the corresponding period last year.
Bajaj Finserv Asset Management recorded assets under management of Rs 35,768 crore as of September 30, 2026.

Bajaj Finserv's three major subsidiaries are Bajaj Finance, Bajaj Life Insurance and Bajaj General Insurance. The company is also expanding its emerging businesses, including Bajaj Finserv Health, Bajaj Finserv Direct, Bajaj Asset Management and Bajaj Alternate Investment Management.
Losses from these emerging businesses stood at Rs 144 crore during the second quarter of FY27.

Bajaj Alternate Investment Management, a wholly owned subsidiary of Bajaj Finserv, commenced its portfolio management services business during the quarter. Its Category II Alternative Investment Fund focused on real estate announced its initial closing in October 2026.
The group has also incorporated Bajaj Reinsurance in October 2026 and will seek the necessary regulatory approvals to begin operations.
